Dr. Vishal Sharma (Ph.D.)

(Principal Investigator)___________________________________________________________
DATE: 24-02-2023
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for the temporary position of 01 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in the research
project entitled “Development of Effective Scientific methods for identification of trace evidence in Crime
against Women” from DFSS, Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), GOI, New Delhi.
Manpower:
01 Junior Research Fellow (JRF): @ 31,000.00 per month (fixed).
Eligibility:
The candidate should have a M.Sc. in the field of Forensic Science or any other allied discipline with
minimum 55% (50% for candidates belonging to SC/ST category) with UGC-NET (LS/JRF)
qualification.
Terms and Conditions:
The position is co-terminus with the project or may be terminated even before (with one month notice if
the work is not found satisfactory). The JRF position is for 01 year and can be extended up to 02 years
only.
How to apply:
Applications on plain paper giving following details must reach the undersigned by 17-03-2023.
Full Bio-data including name, parents name, postal address, email and contact number along with
academic details starting from 10th onwards, list of publications (Scopus and Web of Science only),
patents and experience with the supporting documents.
Application as a single word/PDF file can also be sent by email to drvishalsharma.pu@gmail.com
 The date and time of the interview will be intimated through separate email.
 Send the hard copy of your application along with the required documents to the undersigned.
 The updated details can also be brought at the time of interview, in case application sent through
email.
 No TA/DA shall be applicable for attending the interview.
 The selected candidate will be governed by DFSS-MHA, Government of India and Panjab
University (Chandigarh) rules and regulations. The shortlisted candidates will be intimated for
interview by e-mail. Selection will be based on qualification, and performance in the interview
